credits.title: Karateka
credits.overview: At 39, Spanish karateka Sandra Sánchez sets her sights on Olympic gold in Tokyo, pushing her career toward its defining test. Her coach and life partner, Jesús del Moral, remains beside her throughout, a bond that turns each step toward the Games into a shared act of commitment.

credits.title: Collision Course
credits.overview: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.

credits.title: Subsuelo
credits.overview: Eva and Fabián are twin siblings about to reach adulthood. One summer night, they become involved in a tragic accident. However, their lives and specific circumstances are opaque, and only the two siblings and Mabel, their mother, seem to know them.

credits.title: Last Stop: Rocafort St.
credits.overview: Laura has recently started working in the Barcelona subway. credits.title: Place of Birth
credits.overview: Adele is a 15-year-old girl who is running away from her home country. For this she must make a very hard trip and face nature, human injustice and the purest loneliness. Four Western friends will cross her path.

credits.title: Olvido
credits.overview: After the Turia River overflows its banks, journalist Olvido and police sergeant Fermín investigate the appearance of six bodies with strange scars that point to a dark conspiracy.

credits.title: The Chalk Line
credits.overview: After a couple finds a traumatized child of unknown origins, wife Paula must decipher the girl's strange behaviors to unlock her identity and dark past.

credits.title: Lucas
credits.overview: Lucas just lost his father and everything around him is starting to crumble. One day he meets Alvaro, who offers him money in exchange for some innocent pictures. Álvaro will use them to create fake accounts in social media to “just talk”, he assures, with underage girls. Desperate for money, Lucas takes the deal.

credits.title: Well
credits.overview: A man finds himself at the bottom of a well. No clue as to how he got there. Then, a figure leans in at the top.

credits.title: Seventeen
credits.overview: To find his therapy dog, a 17-year-old escapes from juvie and embarks on a journey of reconnection with his brother and grandmother through Cantabria.

credits.title: Litus
credits.overview: A group of friends reunited after the suicide of one of them must face all the secret and lies between them.

credits.title: Faith
credits.overview: Adolfo, the town's priest, gets a phone call from a desperate family. They believe that their daughter is possessed by the devil.

credits.title: Vampiro
credits.overview: A screenwriter contacts a prostitute to research a character of his new script.

credits.title: People in Places
credits.overview: A fragmented view of contemporary Spain, drawing conclusions about the persistence of the human condition, strangeness, and the chaos within relationships.

credits.title: Una canción
credits.overview: María, an older woman, lawyer, becomes unemployed for honesty. A person like her who believe in the righteousness of God seems to have no place in this society, but does not despair and, while looking for work, write what matters in a notebook.
